//go:build integration
// +build integration

package integration

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

const (
	studentNATSBootstrapTestURL   = "STUDENT_NATS_BOOTSTRAP_TEST_URL"
	studentNATSBootstrapTestAllow = "STUDENT_NATS_BOOTSTRAP_TEST_ALLOW_MUTATION"
)

// This opt-in integration test requires an empty, disposable JetStream account.
// It invokes the repository bootstrap twice and validates the exact stream
// names and contracts without deleting or changing pre-existing streams.
func TestStudentNATSBootstrapIntegration(t *testing.T) {
	serverURL := os.Getenv(studentNATSBootstrapTestURL)
	if serverURL == "" || os.Getenv(studentNATSBootstrapTestAllow) != "1" {
		t.Skipf("set %s and %s=1 to opt into the disposable NATS bootstrap test", studentNATSBootstrapTestURL, studentNATSBootstrapTestAllow)
	}
	if !isLoopbackNATSTestURL(serverURL) {
		t.Fatal("refusing NATS bootstrap mutation for a non-loopback URL; use 127.0.0.1, localhost, or ::1")
	}

	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 45*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if names := studentNATSStreamNames(t, ctx, serverURL); len(names) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("refusing to modify disposable test account with existing streams: %v", names)
	}

	_, sourceFile, _, ok := runtime.Caller(0)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("cannot locate Student NATS bootstrap source")
	}
	repositoryRoot := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(sourceFile), "..", ".."))
	bootstrapScript := filepath.Join(repositoryRoot, "docker", "bootstrap-nats.sh")
	for attempt := 1; attempt <= 2; attempt++ {
		command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "sh", bootstrapScript)
		command.Dir = repositoryRoot
		command.Env = studentNATSBootstrapEnvironment(serverURL)
		if _, err := command.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
			// Do not echo output that may contain the caller's authenticated URL.
			t.Fatalf("Student NATS bootstrap attempt %d failed: %v", attempt, err)
		}
	}

	wantNames := []string{"TASKANSWER_EVENTS", "TEACHER_EVENTS"}
	gotNames := studentNATSStreamNames(t, ctx, serverURL)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(gotNames, wantNames) {
		t.Fatalf("stream names after repeated bootstrap = %v, want exactly %v", gotNames, wantNames)
	}

	studentNATSAssertStreamContract(t, ctx, serverURL, "TEACHER_EVENTS", []string{
		"teacher.assistance.observed",
		"teacher.decision.recorded",
	}, 7*24*time.Hour, 10*time.Minute)
	studentNATSAssertStreamContract(t, ctx, serverURL, "TASKANSWER_EVENTS", []string{
		"learning_action.closed",
		"taskAnswer.autoReview.applied",
		"taskAnswer.reviewed",
		"taskAnswer.started",
	}, 0, 2*time.Minute)
}

func studentNATSStreamNames(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, serverURL string) []string {
	t.Helper()
	payload := studentNATSCommand(t, ctx, serverURL, "stream", "ls", "--json")
	var nameList []string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &nameList); err == nil {
		sort.Strings(nameList)
		return nameList
	}
	var response struct {
		Streams []json.RawMessage `json:"streams"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &response); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode NATS stream list JSON: %v", err)
	}
	names := make([]string, 0, len(response.Streams))
	for _, encoded := range response.Streams {
		var stream struct {
			Name   string `json:"name"`
			Config struct {
				Name string `json:"name"`
			} `json:"config"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &stream); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("decode NATS stream list entry: %v", err)
		}
		name := stream.Name
		if name == "" {
			name = stream.Config.Name
		}
		if name == "" {
			t.Fatalf("NATS stream list entry has no name: %s", encoded)
		}
		names = append(names, name)
	}
	sort.Strings(names)
	return names
}

func studentNATSAssertStreamContract(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, serverURL, name string, subjects []string, maxAge, duplicateWindow time.Duration) {
	t.Helper()
	payload := studentNATSCommand(t, ctx, serverURL, "stream", "info", name, "--json")
	var response struct {
		Config struct {
			Name            string   `json:"name"`
			Subjects        []string `json:"subjects"`
			Retention       string   `json:"retention"`
			Storage         string   `json:"storage"`
			Replicas        int      `json:"num_replicas"`
			MaxAge          any      `json:"max_age"`
			DuplicateWindow any      `json:"duplicate_window"`
		} `json:"config"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &response); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode NATS stream %s JSON: %v", name, err)
	}
	gotSubjects := append([]string(nil), response.Config.Subjects...)
	sort.Strings(gotSubjects)
	if response.Config.Name != name || !reflect.DeepEqual(gotSubjects, subjects) {
		t.Fatalf("NATS stream %s identity/subjects = %q %v, want %q %v", name, response.Config.Name, gotSubjects, name, subjects)
	}
	if !strings.EqualFold(response.Config.Retention, "limits") || !strings.EqualFold(response.Config.Storage, "file") || response.Config.Replicas != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("NATS stream %s retention/storage/replicas = %q/%q/%d, want limits/file/1", name, response.Config.Retention, response.Config.Storage, response.Config.Replicas)
	}
	if got := studentNATSDuration(t, name, "max_age", response.Config.MaxAge); got != int64(maxAge) {
		t.Fatalf("NATS stream %s max_age = %d ns, want %d ns", name, got, maxAge)
	}
	if got := studentNATSDuration(t, name, "duplicate_window", response.Config.DuplicateWindow); got != int64(duplicateWindow) {
		t.Fatalf("NATS stream %s duplicate_window = %d ns, want %d ns", name, got, duplicateWindow)
	}
}

func studentNATSDuration(t *testing.T, stream, field string, value any) int64 {
	t.Helper()
	switch value := value.(type) {
	case float64:
		return int64(value)
	case string:
		duration, err := time.ParseDuration(value)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("parse NATS stream %s %s duration: %v", stream, field, err)
		}
		return int64(duration)
	default:
		t.Fatalf("NATS stream %s %s has unsupported JSON type %T", stream, field, value)
		return 0
	}
}

func studentNATSCommand(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, serverURL string, args ...string) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	commandArgs := append([]string{"--server", serverURL}, args...)
	command := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "nats", commandArgs...)
	output, err := command.Output()
	if err != nil {
		// Keep the supplied URL out of diagnostics because it may contain auth.
		t.Fatalf("NATS CLI %s failed: %v", strings.Join(args, " "), err)
	}
	return output
}

func studentNATSBootstrapEnvironment(serverURL string) []string {
	environment := make([]string, 0, len(os.Environ())+1)
	for _, value := range os.Environ() {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "NATS_URL=") {
			environment = append(environment, value)
		}
	}
	return append(environment, "NATS_URL="+serverURL)
}
